answer_1.quote: We applied two complementary tasks to evaluate the personality expressed by the merged models: the Big Five Inventory (BFI) questionnaire and analysis of linguistic features in generated text.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated instruction-following performance using ALPACAEVAL to ensure that the model's instruction-following capability was preserved.

answer_3.quote: used the GPT API to score responses on a 5-point scale

answer_4.quote: recruited 10 human raters (8 male, 2 female; average age: 29.1) to independently score a sample of 400 GPT-annotated responses
answer_4.guideline: Prior to annotation, we conducted a pre-annotation workshop to calibrate rater understanding, reviewed interpretations of their results, and provided with structured explanations of the Big Five framework and detailed definitions of each trait dimension.
